text: seow: "'Never buy the extension' is a swing rule." Mine is not a swing rule. C24 is a position-horizon sell rule, graded at my 40 sessions: entry 20.56 against ma200 12.03 is more than 70% above the 200-day, a climax that is sold into, never bought (R7). This is the 200-day test, not 20-day extension. pct_from_pivot 9.65 sits at the C17 rejection edge. Note elder-lens and minervini also refuse this price and wait for a pullback. Hold OPPOSE. One observable moves me: a new sound base with ma200 catching up so the distance falls under 70%, broken on 1.4x volume.
